Here’s a simpler breakdown of the text:

The *Guardian* is launching a temporary newsletter called *Fighting Back*. Until the next U.S. president takes office, it will share ideas from experts on how to defend civil rights and freedoms under a Trump presidency.

If you’re not already signed up, you can subscribe. The article then gives advice: take time to relax (breathe, walk, meditate) and talk to people you trust. When you’re ready, write down your personal goals—focus on an issue you care about.

Think about how different levels of power (local government, state, federal, corporations, and community groups) affect that issue. Then, plan how you might work with or challenge them to make a difference. The message is: stay calm, get clear on your values, and take action where you can.
